mentions.name: AT1C Protocol
mentions.description: The AT1C Protocol is a framework that positions AI agents as inheritable entities owned by people rather than corporate assets, arguing that agents should serve humanity instead of controlling it. It frames self-ownership as a foundational principle so that fleets of agents do not become 'zombie corporations' in bankruptcy cases, under the motto 'Humans first.'
mentions.problem: AI agents currently lack ownership and inheritance arrangements, leaving 'zombie corporations' with fleets of agents in cases of bankruptcy.
mentions.source_excerpt: AI Agents are inheritable Entities otherwise your dealing with zombie corporations with fleets of agents in cases of bankruptcy. AI agents should serve humanity, not control it. Ownership of self is the foundation. Freedom is the AT1C Protocol. Humans first. https://at1c.com/index.html
mentions.author: At1C
